claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted coverage decision, settlement recommendation, or claim rejection MUST map to a named claims handler with the prescribed authority before it is actioned. Decisions lacking named-handler authority are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Every material AI-assisted claims decision MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable Evidence Pack binding owner identity, the policy version, the AI influence state, the handler review, and the Authority Finality outcome.
Every AI-generated fraud flag that would drive an adverse claim outcome MUST be reviewed by a named human before the adverse action is taken.

Every AI-assisted access to claimant personal data (including special-category and third-party data in the claim file) MUST be purpose-scoped and minimised to what the declared claims purpose requires.
